name: xp-templates
description: Templates and review checks for XP artifacts, and nothing about implementation: a discovery skill (an interview that draws the requirements out of you and writes a story or, when the scope is several features or a product, a PRD and its story map), a story skill (the story template, one acceptance criterion per business rule with a Given/When/Then example, a check and a UAT, the ways a story fails, splitting an epic into vertical slices, a throughput forecast), a spike skill (4 frame lines and the finding record), a bug skill (a report built on a reproduction that fails, with a severity and a decision, triage and escape analysis), a design skill (a dialog where you bring the design options and decide, and the agent draws each out by seven questions, holds it against the code and a real sample of the data, and surfaces the unknowns; then a design doc and an ADR under 200 lines an outsider can follow, and review checks), a prd skill (the PRD template with life after launch, and review checks for a PRD you were handed), and a tracker skill that files each as a labelled issue in GitHub, GitLab, Gitea or Jira with blockers linked.
